name: hiphop_eval_prompt_compare
_comment: Tests the NEW eff-5000 checkpoint on BOTH prompt styles for ICE (D min 135) and Midnight (B min 110): the old cKz!-filename format (which scored 3.35 / 3.08 on the OLD model) and the new caption format the new model was trained on. Same axes as the old runs (cfg 3, strength 1.0, steps 50, 20 seeds, duration 20) so ratings line up. Filenames encode the prompt, so analyze_ratings groups them and you can see which format the new model prefers.

prompt: crushed keyz, hip hop melody loop, D minor, 135 bpm
crushed keyz, hip hop melody loop, B minor, 110 bpm
